svg.aria-label: JSON JSON into a generic value tree (DOM): throughput of existing implementations
svg.text: JSON into a generic value tree (DOM): speed relative to JsonBeef
one operation: parse into the library's value tree, then release it · geometric mean over the inputs both handled of MB/s ÷ JsonBeef's · higher is better
MB/s · the three fastest implementations of this track on each input · bars scaled per input
* RapidJSON in-situ failed canada and hard floats (default float conversion is not always correctly rounded).
* RapidJSON failed canada and hard floats (default float conversion is not always correctly rounded).
* JSON::XS failed all but citm_catalog, canada, github_events, gsoc-2018 and strings, Unicode (float conversion not correctly rounded;
one integer returned as a string).
* serde_json Value failed canada and hard floats (float conversion not correctly rounded without its float_roundtrip feature).
* lua-cjson (LuaJIT) failed integers (integers above INT64_MAX saturate (strtoll)).
* StructuredData failed all but citm_catalog, github_events, gsoc-2018 and strings, Unicode (fractions stored as 32-bit floats; top-
level arrays of numbers are not read as JSON).
* JsonNode did not settle on records array (noisy figures).
* lua-cjson (Lua 5.5) failed integers (integers above INT64_MAX saturate (strtoll)).
* Newtonsoft JToken did not settle on records array (noisy figures).
* EinScott/json failed all but citm_catalog, github_events and gsoc-2018 (imprecise float parser; no \/ escape).
* Jansson failed integers (rejects integers above INT64_MAX).
* JSON::PP failed strings, Unicode (drops characters after some \u escape sequences); did not settle on NDJSON log and records array
Linux x86-64, single thread, warm · 1 s warm-up, then samples until 60% are within ±10% of their median · median of 3 processes · bench/compare
